title: McDonagh v Ryanair (Case C-12/11), 31 January 2013
excerpt: circumstances such as the closure of part of European airspace as a result of the eruption of the Eyjafjallajökull volcano constitute ‘extraordinary circumstances’ within the meaning of that regulation which do not release air carriers from their obligation laid down in Articles 5(1)(b) and 9 of the regulation to provide care.
summary: Extraordinary circumstances, such as the 2010 volcanic ash closure, do not release the carrier from its duty to provide care.
